title: Berakhot
attributionNote: The Sefaria catalogue records this as a composite or traditionally transmitted work. Authorship is not asserted here beyond the source's own metadata.
description: Blessings and prayers, focusing on Shema and the Amidah. Complete Talmud text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: The Talmud records rabbinic debate, law and narrative from late antiquity. The Bavli and Yerushalmi are separate compilations with different structure and transmission histories.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
